verdict.rationale: Evidence shows strong support for Delaware C-corp formation via the Clerky partnership (incorporation, bylaws, 83(b) elections, founder stock), but the firm's offices are all U.S.-based and there is no evidence of guidance on UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, or Indian Pvt Ltd structures or jurisdiction-choice comparisons for founders operating outside the U.S. missing for 10: guidance on non-U.S. entity types (UK, Germany, India), comparative jurisdiction-selection content, any international incorporation practice evidence.
